acceptance: worktree-create with BASE set to a local branch creates the worktree at that branch's resolved commit and records the same OID in metadata.
If the ref moves between resolution and creation, the worktree is still created at the recorded OID (race test).
Without BASE, behaviour matches today except that the worktree is created from the resolved OID; the existing refusals still fire.
pr-preflight BASE=<commit> selects tests only for paths changed since that commit; without BASE it is unchanged.
